This seems to explain a lot of jailbreaks. The piece is most useful for readers who care about how training choices affect stability, cost, and final model quality in real workflows. For the digest, Thoughts on Role Confusion stands out because it offers enough concrete detail to be useful, while also surfacing the tradeoffs that matter when people evaluate tools, models, and implementation decisions.
